Hi Julia + team,

Thanks again for running the trial with us so far. Per our sync this morning, I wanted to capture the sprint plan for the week and call out owners so we can close against the MAP timeline. I attached a one‑page POC readiness checklist (POC-readiness-checklist.xlsx).

Quick summary of current status:
- Eval plan baseline: ready (test harness + 3 acceptance scenarios)
- Primary blocker: procurement PO and network whitelist for our private endpoint
- Secondary risk: security evidence (SOC2 report) needs final review by Nimbus security lead

Proposed owners / immediate actions (owners in parentheses):
- Procurement/PO submission & follow-up (Ben Carter) — target: 2026-09-03
- Network allowlist + VPC testing (Marissa Cole) — target: 2026-09-02
- Eval criteria run & baseline metrics (Karthik Iyer) — target: 2026-09-04
- Security evidence handoff (Vanessa Ortiz) — target: 2026-09-03

Can we confirm those owners on your side and whether procurement has a contact? If those targets look good I’ll consolidate into a short action table and share after today’s call.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Vanessa, thanks — clear and helpful. Quick answers from our side: 
- Procurement contact: procurement@nimbushealth.com (cc’d). They typically need an SOW + standard PO; I’ve asked them to expect Ben’s outreach.
- Security: our security lead (Marcus Lee) will review the SOC2; he asked for a short summary of data flow. Can you drop the data flow sketch into the Drive link you shared?

Blockers we see:
- Network allowlist window: our infra team can do a weekday window (2026-09-02 afternoon) but we need IPs ahead of time.
- PO turnaround: procurement team is quick once they have the SOW, but they require the SLA appendix.

We’re aligned on owners — I’ll surface any procurement turnaround constraints as soon as I hear back.

—Julia
